title.zh: Power Platform按量付费开通指南
title.en: Power Platform Pay-as-You-Go Billing Plan Setup Guide

summary.zh: 面向客户团队，逐步交接开通前提、平台与 Azure 权限，完成计费计划、环境和产品核对，再安排成本告警与安全停用。
summary.en: A customer setup manual with per-step prerequisites and scoped roles for billing plans, environments, product checks, cost alerts, and safe disabling.
